name: Rntor
description:
Rntor connects Claude to your coworking and flexible workspace management platform, giving authorized operators secure access to live operational data for reporting, member support, billing reviews, and everyday decision-making.

Rntor helps workspace operators deliver better member experiences through automated operations, built-in AI, centralized administration, and branded member experiences for signing up, booking resources, managing subscriptions, paying invoices, shopping, accessing benefits, and finding support.

This connector lets Claude securely query your live Rntor data directly in conversation, helping you answer operational questions and analyze your business without switching between screens or building reports manually.

Key capabilities include:

• View the networks and locations you are authorized to access, including their configuration and operational status.
• Look up members and companies while respecting network permissions and protected contact information.
• Explore rooms, desks, offices, parking spaces, equipment, and their bookings.
• Review membership and resource plans, active subscriptions, renewal dates, and account status.
• Retrieve invoice records and balances for billing checks, reconciliation, and reporting.
• Review contracts and contract templates for status checks, renewals, and operational follow-up.
• Explore shop categories, products, and orders across your locations.
• Review member benefits, benefit categories, and submitted benefit applications.
• Access published member guides and operational information directly from Claude.

Every connection is authenticated through Rntor OAuth and restricted to the selected network, environment, and permissions of the signed-in user.

The connector is currently read-only. It can retrieve and analyze authorized Rntor data, but it cannot create, edit, approve, cancel, or delete business records.

Built by Rntor Technologies for modern coworking and flexible workspace operators.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Rntor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Rntor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.rntor.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Rntor MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rntor lists 35 MCP tools, including getBenefit, getBenefitApplication, getBenefitApplications, getBenefitCategories, getBenefitCategory, getBenefits, getBooking, getBookings, getContract, getContracts, getCurrentUser, and getCustomer.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Rntor?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Rntor in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Rntor requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Rntor is developed by Rntor. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
